name: tauri-app-builder
description: Build, audit and ship Tauri 2 apps with native behavior: desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux) windows, dialogs, frame, notifications and WebView lifecycle; mobile (Android, iOS) permissions, capture, auth, builds and store delivery; start a new app or wrap a web app for Windows and Android. Ships the Tauri MCP server, a live-debug skill and commands to debug, build and verify a running app.
